body:
# Catablepon

Catablepon are a low-level Slayer task assigned by Mazchna, found in the Stronghold of Security beneath Barbarian Village. They need no Slayer level. With high stab (+40) and range (+40) defensive bonuses, a crush weapon (their lowest bonus at +20) is the most accurate choice. They attack with stab melee and magic for up to 6 damage, so bring food. There is no elemental weakness; the three combat-level forms (levels 49/64/68) all count for the task.
